title: Method for inline determination of cleaning-in-place endpoint in ultrafiltration systems using combined permeate UV absorbance and conductivity criteria

record.title: Method for inline determination of cleaning-in-place endpoint in ultrafiltration systems using combined permeate UV absorbance and conductivity criteria
record.abstract: The invention describes a method for determining the endpoint of a cleaning-in-place cycle in cross-flow ultrafiltration systems processing protein-containing streams. The method uses simultaneous inline measurement of permeate-side UV absorbance at 280 nm and electrical conductivity to generate a composite cleaning completion index. A CIP cycle is considered complete when both signals fall below predefined thresholds for a defined duration, replacing fixed-time cleaning protocols. The method reduces reagent consumption and membrane exposure to cleaning agents compared with conventional time-based protocols, without compromising cleaning efficacy as assessed by pure water flux recovery measurement.
